title: What happens when you hit send
note: One continuous shot, so one scene. TheLifecycle is the whole film: the set is built once in lifecycle_set.py and the camera flies through it. There is deliberately nothing to concatenate — cutting between scenes is what this format is built to avoid. The budget moved from 45s to 50s when the end-of-film beat was rebuilt: one lap of the plant, then ten decode cycles inside the box, one word each. The loop is the point of the film, so it is not compressed to defend the old number.
